checks_method: Every sampled GT frame was rectified through its own GT fit and stacked by fret number (build_eval_v2.py strips -> review/eval-v2/strips/); numbering verified by eye from inlay columns, nut and board end; wire positions checked on full-res zooms (build_eval_v2.py zoom) on >=1 frame per clip. GT wires beyond the clip's fret count (board-end edge / pickup labelled as a wire by the pipeline) are removed.
